/traveller-guide/.title: Tanzania Traveller Guide and Trip FAQs | Your Tanzania Trip
/traveller-guide/.description: One place to plan a Tanzania trip: FAQs, travel times between parks, safari vehicles, a typical day, and tips for honeymoons and families. Ask us anything.

/sustainability-policy/.title: Sustainability Policy for Tanzania Trips | Your Tanzania Trip
/sustainability-policy/.description: Our sustainability policy: principles, goals and focus areas for conservation, local communities and suppliers, less waste and fair wages on Tanzania trips.

/safari-in-tanzania-in-december-and-janu.title: Safari in Tanzania in December and January | Your Tanzania Trip
/safari-in-tanzania-in-december-and-janu.description: December and January in Tanzania: hot, dry days of 20 to 30°C, wildlife near water and sample routes with Zanzibar or Mafia. We plan it around your dates.

/diamond-luxury/.title: Diamond Luxury Safaris in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/diamond-luxury/.description: Safari by day, top-end lodges by night: Diamond Luxury routes through Tarangire, Ngorongoro and the Serengeti, some with Zanzibar or a flying safari.

/privacy-policy/.title: Privacy Policy for yourtanzaniatrip.com | Your Tanzania Trip
/privacy-policy/.description: How Your Tanzania Trip collects, uses and protects your personal data when you request a quote or contact us, when it goes to suppliers and how to opt out.

/tanzania-honeymoon/.title: Tanzania and Zanzibar Honeymoon Trips | Your Tanzania Trip
/tanzania-honeymoon/.description: Honeymoon ideas for Tanzania and Zanzibar: a private safari in the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, romantic lodges and beach days. We tailor every route to you.

/family-tours/.title: Tanzania Family Safaris and Holidays | Your Tanzania Trip
/family-tours/.description: Family safaris in Tanzania: routes through the Serengeti and Ngorongoro, beach time on Zanzibar, lodges with pools and car seats on request. Built for kids.

/safari-in-tanzania-in-november/.title: Safari in Tanzania in November | Your Tanzania Trip
/safari-in-tanzania-in-november/.description: November brings the short rains: brief afternoon showers, green plains, fewer vehicles, lower lodge rates and herds back in the Serengeti. See sample routes.

/a-safari-in-tanzania-in-july-and-august.title: Safari in Tanzania in July and August | Your Tanzania Trip
/a-safari-in-tanzania-in-july-and-august.description: July and August in Tanzania: cool, dry weather of 15 to 25°C for game drives, Mara River routes and Zanzibar combinations. We fit it to your summer dates.

/exceptional-travel-tanzania/.title: Tailor-Made Luxury Safaris in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/exceptional-travel-tanzania/.description: Luxury travel in Tanzania made to measure: hand-picked lodges, private and flying safaris, the southern parks and sample routes to adapt. Tell us your wishes.

/islands/.title: Zanzibar, Pemba, Mafia: Tanzania's Islands | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/.description: Tanzania's islands at a glance: Zanzibar, Pemba, Mafia, Mnemba, Chumbe and Fanjove, with coral reefs, quiet beaches and diving. We add one to your safari.

/islands/mnemba-island/.title: Mnemba Island, Zanzibar: Lodge and Diving | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/mnemba-island/.description: Mnemba, a private island off Zanzibar: twelve beach bandas, a protected reef for diving and snorkelling, dolphins, and turtles nesting in February and March.

/islands/mafia/.title: Mafia Island: Whale Sharks and Coral Reefs | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/mafia/.description: Mafia Island is quiet: no tarmac roads, a marine park with over 460 fish species, whale sharks, turtles and humpback whales. A calm finish after your safari.

/islands/chumbe-island/.title: Chumbe Island Coral Park near Zanzibar | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/chumbe-island/.description: Chumbe Island Coral Park near Stone Town: a protected reef and forest reserve with one seven-bungalow eco-lodge, closed from 1 April to 3 June each year.

/islands/fanjove-island/.title: Fanjove Island: Private Eco-Island Stay | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/fanjove-island/.description: Fanjove, south of Mafia: six solar-powered eco-bandas, turtles nesting April to July, humpback whales May to September, dhow sailing and kayaking.

/islands/pemba/.title: Pemba Island: Diving, Snorkelling and Lodges | Your Tanzania Trip
/islands/pemba/.description: Pemba in the Zanzibar Archipelago: reefs around the island, diving in the Pemba channel, kayaking, sunset dhow cruises and eco-lodges. Quiet and romantic.

/national-parks-tanzania/.title: Tanzania National Parks Guide | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks-tanzania/.description: Every Tanzania national park in one overview: the Serengeti, Ngorongoro, Tarangire and Kilimanjaro in the north, and quieter parks such as Nyerere and Katavi.

/terms-conditions/.title: Terms and Conditions for Booking a Trip | Your Tanzania Trip
/terms-conditions/.description: The booking terms of Your Tanzania Trip, registered in the Netherlands (KvK 97223344): privacy, changes to the terms, payments, cancellations and your rights.

/faqs/.title: Tanzania Trip FAQs: Safari, Visas, Money | Your Tanzania Trip
/faqs/.description: Practical questions about a Tanzania trip, answered by us: safari days, Kilimanjaro, Zanzibar, visas, money, safety and packing. Not listed? Send a message.

/faqs/chapka/.title: Chapka Travel Insurance FAQ for Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/faqs/chapka/.description: Chapka travel insurance for a Tanzania trip: why travellers choose it, getting started, help during your trip, and how claims and support work.

/national-parks/lake-manyara/.title: Lake Manyara National Park: Lions and Tips | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/lake-manyara/.description: Lake Manyara: a soda lake below the Rift Valley escarpment, tree-climbing lions, elephants, baboons and birds, plus canopy walks and night game drives.

/national-parks/lake-eyasi/.title: Lake Eyasi: Hadzabe Bushmen and Birdlife | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/lake-eyasi/.description: Lake Eyasi, a seasonal salt lake below the Ngorongoro highlands: meet the Hadzabe hunter-gatherers and see flamingos, pelicans and hippos. No Big Five here.

/national-parks/kilwa-kisiwani/.title: Kilwa Kisiwani Ruins: Swahili Coast History | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/kilwa-kisiwani/.description: Kilwa Kisiwani off southern Tanzania: the Great Mosque, Husuni Kubwa palace and a Portuguese fort, a UNESCO site since 1981. We add it to a southern trip.

/national-parks/pangani/.title: Pangani: Quiet Beaches on Tanzania's Coast | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/pangani/.description: Pangani, a sleepy coastal town south of Tanga: quiet mainland beaches, Arab and European architecture, snorkelling, diving, kayaking and dhow trips.

/national-parks/mount-kilimanjaro/.title: Climbing Mount Kilimanjaro: What to Expect | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mount-kilimanjaro/.description: Before you climb Kilimanjaro: no climbing experience needed, a new vegetation zone every day and a half, altitude, training and gear. We plan it with you.

/national-parks/lake-natron/.title: Lake Natron: Flamingos and Ol Doinyo Lengai | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/lake-natron/.description: Lake Natron, a soda lake at the foot of the active volcano Ol Doinyo Lengai, where over two million flamingos breed. Expect heat above 40°C and red water.

/national-parks/rubondo-island-national-.title: Rubondo Island National Park, Lake Victoria | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/rubondo-island-national-.description: Rubondo Island in Lake Victoria: uninhabited and 90% forest, with sitatunga, otters, hippos, chimpanzees and rich birdlife. A remote and quiet national park.

/national-parks/ndutu/.title: Ndutu: Wildebeest Calving Season in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/ndutu/.description: Ndutu, south of the Serengeti: the migration arrives around late December and calves until March, drawing lions, cheetahs and wild dogs. We time your visit.

/national-parks/ruaha-national-park/.title: Ruaha National Park: Elephants and Lions | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/ruaha-national-park/.description: Ruaha in central Tanzania: big elephant herds, close to 10% of Africa's lions, kudu, sable and roan antelope, 571 bird species and few visitors.

/national-parks/kigoma/.title: Kigoma: Gateway to Gombe and Mahale Chimps | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/kigoma/.description: Kigoma on Lake Tanganyika: the base for chimpanzee trekking in Gombe Stream and Mahale Mountains, with the Livingstone Memorial Museum and direct flights.

/national-parks/mwanza/.title: Mwanza: Rock City on Lake Victoria | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mwanza/.description: Mwanza on Lake Victoria, Tanzania's second city: Bismarck Rock, colonial buildings and a handy start or end point for a Serengeti safari or Rubondo Island.

/national-parks/masai-mara-national-rese.title: Masai Mara and the Great Migration | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/masai-mara-national-rese.description: Kenya's Masai Mara borders the Serengeti: herds arrive from August to mid October to cross the Mara River, and you can visit a Maasai village. Ask us more.

/national-parks/katavi-national-park/.title: Katavi National Park: Buffalo and Hippos | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/katavi-national-park/.description: Katavi in remote southwest Tanzania: huge buffalo herds, around 4,000 elephants, packed hippo pools late in the dry season, and roan and sable antelope.

/national-parks/arusha-national-park/.title: Arusha National Park: Mount Meru, Canoeing | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/arusha-national-park/.description: Arusha National Park, 45 minutes from Arusha: Mount Meru climbs and day hikes, canoe and walking safaris at the Momella Lakes, colobus monkeys and flamingos.

/national-parks/dar-es-salaam/.title: Dar es Salaam: History, Beaches and Markets | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/dar-es-salaam/.description: Dar es Salaam, Tanzania's largest city and main arrival point: colonial history, one of East Africa's largest markets and beaches north and south of town.

/national-parks/nyerere-national-park/.title: Nyerere National Park, the Former Selous | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/nyerere-national-park/.description: Nyerere, formerly Selous: a UNESCO site larger than Denmark with lions, wild dogs, hippos, crocodiles and over 445 bird species, far quieter than the north.

/national-parks/tarangire/.title: Tarangire: Elephants, Baobabs and Birdlife | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/tarangire/.description: Tarangire National Park: baobabs, elephant herds of up to 300 along the river in the dry season, rich birdlife, lions and walking safaris. We fit it in.

/national-parks/nairobi/.title: Nairobi: Kenya's Capital and National Park | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/nairobi/.description: Nairobi, Kenya's capital: the Karen Blixen house, a good museum and Nairobi National Park at the city's edge, with lions, giraffes and black rhino.

/national-parks/mahale-mountains-nationa.title: Mahale Mountains: Chimpanzee Trekking | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mahale-mountains-nationa.description: Mahale Mountains on Lake Tanganyika: hike forest slopes to around 900 habituated chimpanzees. No roads, access by boat only and sunsets over the lake.

/national-parks/mikumi-national-park/.title: Mikumi National Park: Safari in the South | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mikumi-national-park/.description: Mikumi in southern Tanzania: lions on the Mkata floodplain, elephants, giraffes, eland, hippo pools near the gate and over 400 bird species, next to Nyerere.

/national-parks/ngorongoro/.title: Ngorongoro Crater: Big Five and Maasai | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/ngorongoro/.description: Ngorongoro Conservation Area: a 20 km wide crater with all of the Big Five, plus Olduvai Gorge, Empakaai and Maasai herders. We plan your crater day.

/national-parks/tanga/.title: Tanga: Coastal Town in Northern Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/tanga/.description: Tanga on the Indian Ocean near Kenya: a calm city with German colonial history, faded architecture and wide streets, close to Pangani and the Usambaras.

/national-parks/mkomazi-national-park/.title: Mkomazi National Park: Dry Bush Wilderness | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mkomazi-national-park/.description: Mkomazi borders Kenya's Tsavo: dry bush with baobabs, views of Kilimanjaro, lesser kudu, oryx, elephants and over 400 bird species. Off the usual route.

/national-parks/mufindi-highlands/.title: Mufindi Highlands: Tea Country Retreat | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/mufindi-highlands/.description: The Mufindi Highlands in southern Tanzania: tea estates, rainforest, cool air, horse riding, mountain biking, kayaking and fly fishing, 4 hours from Ruaha.

/national-parks/serengeti/.title: Serengeti National Park and the Migration | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/serengeti/.description: Serengeti National Park: almost 15,000 km² of plains with the Big Five, the year-round migration and Mara and Grumeti river crossings. We time your route.

/national-parks/saadani-national-park/.title: Saadani National Park: Bush Meets Beach | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/saadani-national-park/.description: Saadani, the only East African park on the Indian Ocean: game drives and beach in one stay, with giraffes, elephants, hippos and mangroves. Wildlife is shy.

/national-parks/usambara-mountains/.title: Usambara Mountains: Hiking and Birdwatching | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/usambara-mountains/.description: The Usambara Mountains in northeast Tanzania: cool hiking country with rainforest, villages and markets, and endemic birds such as the Usambara eagle-owl.

/national-parks/makuyuni-wildlife-park/.title: Makuyuni Wildlife Park near Arusha | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/makuyuni-wildlife-park/.description: Makuyuni Wildlife Park, 70 km from Arusha on the Serengeti road: lions, elephants, giraffes, walking safaris and a hike up Kipara Hill, with few visitors.

/national-parks/gombe-stream-national-pa.title: Gombe Stream: Chimpanzees and Jane Goodall | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/gombe-stream-national-pa.description: Gombe Stream on Lake Tanganyika, where Jane Goodall studied chimpanzees: guided forest hikes to wild chimps, plus baboons, colobus and over 200 bird species.

/national-parks/bagamoyo/.title: Bagamoyo: History of an Old Port Town | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/bagamoyo/.description: Bagamoyo on the Swahili coast: the Kaole ruins, caravan and slave trade history, a starting point for Livingstone and Stanley, and a former colonial capital.

/national-parks/udzungwa-mountains-natio.title: Udzungwa Mountains: Primates and Rainforest | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/udzungwa-mountains-natio.description: Udzungwa Mountains National Park: rainforest hikes, six primate species including the Iringa red colobus and Sanje mangabey, and over 400 bird species.

/national-parks/kitulo-national-park/.title: Kitulo Plateau: Tanzania's Park of Flowers | Your Tanzania Trip
/national-parks/kitulo-national-park/.description: Kitulo Plateau in the southern highlands: about 400 plant species and over 45 orchids, with meadows in bloom from November to April. A stop for plant lovers.

/travel-times-and-distances/.title: Safari Travel Times in East Africa | Your Tanzania Trip
/travel-times-and-distances/.description: Why safari distances take longer than at home, with route guides for Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda: realistic drive times, domestic flights and popular routes.

/travel-times-and-distances/tanzania/.title: Tanzania Travel Times and Driving Distances | Your Tanzania Trip
/travel-times-and-distances/tanzania/.description: Realistic drive times in Tanzania, like Arusha to Tarangire in about 2 hours or Ngorongoro to central Serengeti in 3.5, plus southern and Zanzibar routes.

/honeymoon-faq/.title: Honeymoon FAQ: Safari and Beach in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/honeymoon-faq/.description: Answers for couples planning a Tanzania honeymoon: safari plus Zanzibar, private safaris, romantic lodges and when to travel. Still unsure? Ask us directly.

/families-faq/.title: Family Safari FAQ: Tanzania with Children | Your Tanzania Trip
/families-faq/.description: Travelling to Tanzania with kids: the right age for a first safari, keeping long drives manageable and lodges with family rooms. Your questions answered.

/safari-in-tanzania-in-october/.title: Safari in Tanzania in October | Your Tanzania Trip
/safari-in-tanzania-in-october/.description: October in Tanzania: the dry season peaks, animals gather at water, elephants fill Tarangire and wildebeest roam the Serengeti, with more lodge space free.

/adventure-trips-tanzania/.title: Adventure Travel in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/adventure-trips-tanzania/.description: Active trips in Tanzania built around you: climb Kilimanjaro, track wild chimpanzees, camp in the Serengeti and end at the coast. Sample routes to start from.

/serengeti-safari/.title: Serengeti Safari: Balloon Rides and Regions | Your Tanzania Trip
/serengeti-safari/.description: Planning a Serengeti safari: the northern, central and western areas, hot air balloon flights, the Big Five, wild dogs and pangolins. We match area to month.

/vehicles/tanzania/.title: Tanzania Safari Jeeps: Toyota Land Cruisers | Your Tanzania Trip
/vehicles/tanzania/.description: The 4x4 Toyota Land Cruisers used on safari: 5 or 7 seats, a pop-up roof, big windows, a window seat for all, charging ports and a fridge. No AC on board.

/newsletter/.title: Sign Up for the Tanzania Travel Newsletter | Your Tanzania Trip
/newsletter/.description: Subscribe to the Your Tanzania Trip newsletter for travel ideas, routes, traveller stories and news from Tanzania by e-mail. Unsubscribe whenever you like.

/what-to-expect/.title: A Typical Safari Day: What to Expect | Your Tanzania Trip
/what-to-expect/.description: What a typical day looks like on safari in Tanzania, Kenya and Uganda, or on a Kilimanjaro climb: early starts, game drives and evenings, almost hour by hour.

/tanzania-travel/.title: Tanzania Tours and Sample Itineraries | Your Tanzania Trip
/tanzania-travel/.description: Sample Tanzania itineraries to start from: safari with Zanzibar, Big Five routes, beach stays and Kilimanjaro climbs. We adjust the route, lodges and pace.

/tanzania-travel/multi-day/.title: Multi-Day Safari Tours in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/tanzania-travel/multi-day/.description: Multi-day tours in Tanzania that combine national parks, the Indian Ocean, cultural visits or Kilimanjaro, with less to arrange yourself. Start from a sample.

/tanzania-travel/adventure/.title: Tanzania Adventure Tours and Safaris | Your Tanzania Trip
/tanzania-travel/adventure/.description: From snorkelling a sandbank to a first Big Five sighting or climbing Kilimanjaro: adventure ideas for Tanzania, with sample safaris shaped to your pace.

/tanzania-travel/private-tours/.title: Private Safari Tours in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/tanzania-travel/private-tours/.description: Private safaris in Tanzania for couples, families and friends: your own pace, a route set by your group, and sample trips via the Serengeti and Zanzibar.

/practical-information/easy-payments/.title: Paying for Your Tanzania Trip | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/easy-payments/.description: How to pay for your safari: bank transfer to a Dutch account, or credit card, Amex, iDeal, Bancontact and more, with IBAN and BIC explained. No PayPal.

/practical-information/tanzania-yellow-f.title: Tanzania Yellow Fever Vaccine: Is It Needed | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/tanzania-yellow-f.description: Do you need a yellow fever vaccination for Tanzania? Not if you fly in from Europe or the US. Proof is only asked when you arrive from a country with risk.

/practical-information/travel-insurance/.title: Travel Insurance for a Tanzania Safari | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/travel-insurance/.description: Why travel insurance matters on a Tanzania safari, what it should cover, such as medical care, cancellation and lost luggage, and why we suggest Chapka.

/practical-information/visa-tanzania/.title: Tanzania Visa: How to Apply | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/visa-tanzania/.description: Getting a tourist visa for Tanzania: applying online or on arrival, the pros and cons of each, the multi-entry visa for US citizens and what to have ready.

/practical-information/guarantees/.title: How Your Booking Is Protected | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/guarantees/.description: What we guarantee when you book: who you book with, written confirmation from our local partner in Arusha, a clear price, deposit and balance, one account.

/practical-information/responsible-trave.title: Responsible Travel in Tanzania | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/responsible-trave.description: How we and our local partner in Arusha travel responsibly: solar-powered lodges on request, fair pay and gear for Kilimanjaro porters, first-aid trained crew.

/practical-information/when-to-visit-tan.title: When to Visit Tanzania: Seasons Explained | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/when-to-visit-tan.description: When to go to Tanzania: June to October for dry-season game viewing and river crossings, December to February for calving, and quieter green months between.

/practical-information/tanzania-travel-a.title: Tanzania Travel Advice: Safety and Visas | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/tanzania-travel-a.description: Practical Tanzania travel advice: is it safe, who lives there, which languages are spoken, do you need a visa, and more questions travellers ask before going.

/practical-information/tanzania-weather/.title: Tanzania Weather: Rainy and Dry Seasons | Your Tanzania Trip
/practical-information/tanzania-weather/.description: Tanzania weather: 22 to 31°C by day, short rains late October to December, long rains late March to early June, and why a safari still works in the wet.

/discover-tanzania/.title: Discover Tanzania: Parks, Islands, Planning | Your Tanzania Trip
/discover-tanzania/.description: A starting point for a first Tanzania trip: national parks, islands, the Big Five, the year-round migration and practical planning tips, all from one page.

/travel-quiz/.title: Tanzania Travel Quiz: Find Your Safari | Your Tanzania Trip
/travel-quiz/.description: Answer five short questions for a suggested Tanzania itinerary: a northern safari, safari and Zanzibar, the migration, the south or Kilimanjaro. Two minutes.
